title: Number of Valid Subarrays
statement_html:
Given an integer array nums, return the number of valid subarrays.

A subarray nums[i..j] (i <= j) is valid if nums[i] is the minimum element of that subarray, i.e. the leftmost element is not larger than any other element in it.

Input: line 1 has n; line 2 has the n integers of nums.

Output: a single integer: the number of valid subarrays.

Example 1:

Input:
5
1 4 2 5 3
Output: 11
Explanation: [1], [4], [2], [5], [3], [1,4], [2,5], [1,4,2], [2,5,3], [1,4,2,5], [1,4,2,5,3].

Example 2:

Input:
3
3 2 1
Output: 3
Explanation: Only the single-element subarrays.

Example 3:

Input:
3
1 1 1
Output: 6
Explanation: Every subarray is valid.

Example 4:

Input:
1
5
Output: 1

Constraints:

  • 1 <= n <= 105

  • -105 <= nums[i] <= 105

This is LeetCode #1063 (premium), so the statement here is written from the DomJudge version.
